title: Operations admission and provisioning lock coverage
description:
Implement operations admission and provisioning recovery on a dedicated branch after the current operations branch is merged. This is a separate workstream and no longer a readiness/consolidation prerequisite of tas-561x. Existing tas-561x.9 is superseded by this transfer, not completed implementation.

Canonical design: docs/specs/2026-09-18-provisioning-lock-coverage-proposal.md. Continuation: docs/handoffs/operations-lock-coverage.md. Independent scoped correctness review is complete; ownership/manual-recovery direction is approved, but complete written-design and implementation-plan approval remain pending. Design/review evidence is retained on tas-561x.9.

Preserve pyinfra and the inner lifecycle lock. Use one fixed host-wide admission flock and one root-private provisioning reservation bound to the confirmed installation. Only specified nested provisioning calls may use its owner ID; conflicts fail with status 12; owner ID is never safe-completion proof. Uncertain provisioning retains the reservation and backup suspension pending explicit inspection/manual recovery, with no automatic caller-loss termination guarantee, expiry/PID clearance or optimistic timer restart. design: Approved design: docs/specs/2026-09-06-deployment-controller-simplification-design.md. title: Allow provisioning to reach creation of an absent application database
description:
Fresh provisioning was blocked because credential preflight attempted application database authentication before convergence could create absent identities. Investigation also found filtered compatibility queries could classify incompatible identities as absent. Original source checkpoint was 6aec274046071729ae4da796ed52edf3f4dbc4cf; investigation baseline f654b4389b2efe78648204c6e05a23753d89a6cf.

Operator approved the bounded correction on 2026-09-18. Implemented and committed locally as b5f86e11450128711d61a15065055df7980c6877: discovery preserves incompatible identity presence; only both role/database genuinely absent permit creation, retained role plus missing database refuses. Validated ready/absent authority reaches the private pgpass entry. Absent mode preserves exact record/file authority and skips only impossible authentication; ready mode must authenticate. Runtime checks remain unconditional. Existing convergence rechecks authority, creates exact identities via protected stdin and proves the final application connection.

Distinct scoped review found no findings; independently reproduced 236 focused tests and two actual native container SQL/creation/SCRAM proofs. Full operations 1642 passed/five opt-in skips; mix precommit 811 passed. Evidence/commands/adapter limits: docs/research/2026-09-17-operations-vps-acceptance.md#verified-fresh-install-correction.

Operator subsequently authorized clearing disposable deploy for fresh provisioning on 2026-09-18. Reviewed scoped reset preserved a hash-verified offhost current database dump, all six dump/metadata pairs, releases/deployment records/protected configuration, and original managed paths in root-only quarantine. Both native role/database and managed installation/config are now absent; SSH/Caddy/PostgreSQL retained active. Application intentionally stopped pending corrected first provision.

Native public dry-run of clean checkpoint 47b61335b698 (tree equal d7b15e5802e2) exposed a second boundary: generic discover(mode=provision) requires absent pgpass before the private preflight, used by both target admission and downgrade planning. Existing controller fixture no-op masked it. Shared authoritative observation correction committed as 2d809465fc50a5fce1de453199df0b148b37428a. Public RED/GREEN regressions reproduced old refusal and pass; independent scoped review found no findings, 151 focused/one skip and two native proofs passed; full operations 1652 passed/five skips and precommit 811 passed. Strict/deploy/restore unchanged. Native read-only current-fix/older-artifact probe now admits absent authority without mutation. Corrected evidence: docs/research/2026-09-17-operations-vps-acceptance.md#verified-generic-provisioning-observation. Evidence: docs/research/2026-09-17-operations-vps-acceptance.md#authorized-disposable-host-reset-and-public-planning-diagnosis.

Native acceptance completed on clean corrected source 4ac7b24ce9f709106a03a3126afd7b4e32b054f2 (tree equal addf0e428e5c3de32b333abcbffc199d3cd02ca5): public dry-run planned without mutation; first provision succeeded; identical rerun returned already-provisioned with no mutation. All eight readiness checks passed on first, repeat and independent standalone verification. Native SQL, permissions, artifact/migration binding and preserved recovery hashes independently verified. Fresh database is empty with no administrator; retained compatible OS services mean this is not pristine-OS acceptance. Evidence: docs/research/2026-09-17-operations-vps-acceptance.md#native-fresh-provisioning-and-converged-rerun.

title: Restore administrator password prompting on the pinned release runtime
description: Live staging create-admin fails immediately at Password before input; confirmation and Accounts.bootstrap_admin are never reached. Reproduced using only Taskman.LocalTerminal.prompt_secret in the selected OTP 27.3.4.6 release through systemd-run, without account creation. Both --pipe and diagnostic --pty return input_unavailable. Direct diagnostic shows shell.start_interactive({noshell, raw}) returns ok, io.getopts(user) reports echo=false, and io.get_password(user) returns {error,enotsup}. OTP-27.3.4.6 lib/kernel/src/group.erl get_password_chars explicitly rejects echo=false (https://github.com/erlang/otp/blob/OTP-27.3.4.6/lib/kernel/src/group.erl#L507-L523). LocalTerminal starts raw mode before get_password. Local tests use OTP 29 and the operations PTY test substitutes systemd-run, so current tests do not establish pinned native-runtime compatibility. Determine a secure cross-runtime prompt sequence, verify synthetic password and confirmation remain unechoed under the actual pinned runtime and native service bridge, preserve cleanup on interruption, and improve bounded input failure diagnostics as appropriate. No code fix, release deployment, or administrator creation performed during diagnosis; obtain operator approval for implementation and separately for deployment.
notes: Real-host administrator acceptance completed on 2026-09-09 after the operator privately ran create-admin and reported signing in. Browser inspection independently confirmed the authenticated workspace and successful /admin access with the sole user active and Admin? true. Normal Sign out returned to sign-in; a fresh /admin navigation redirected to /sign-in?return_to=%2Fadmin, with no admin table. Password and tokens were never captured. Prior exact-runtime PTY and native bridge tests establish synthetic secrecy/restoration; current real-host account/login outcome is confirmed without claiming captured terminal diagnostics. Deployment reconciliation tas-sr4b remains separately incomplete.
close_reason: Pinned-runtime administrator creation and real-host login/admin/logout acceptance succeeded
